notes.title: ❤️ Thank You, Soldiers ❤️
notes.notes: [h3]❤️ Thank You, Soldiers ❤️[/h3][p]The [b]Steam TPS Fest[/b] has officially come to a close, and with it, our playtest has also wrapped up — after giving everyone one extra day of fun on the battlefield.[/p][p]We want to take a moment to say a massive [b]thank you[/b] to everyone who played, watched, shared, and showed love toward [b]Shadows of Soldiers[/b] during the Fest. Your excitement, feedback, and support mean the world to our small team, and it’s what keeps us pushing forward. 🫡[/p][p]Along the way, we ran into both new and old bugs (and yes, even a few server issues) — but thanks to your help, we now have a much clearer view of what to improve as we move ahead. Every bug report, every piece of feedback, and every word of encouragement helps us get closer to delivering the tactical shooter we all want to see.[/p][p]This is just the beginning. We’ll be back with more updates, more improvements, and more opportunities for you to join the fight. Until then… thank you for being part of this journey with us. ❤️[/p][p]See you soon on the battlefield.[/p][p]— The Shadows of Soldiers Team[/p]

notes.notes:

notes.title: ✅ Playtest Recap & What’s Next
notes.notes:
[p]Our July playtest weekend has come to a close — and we want to give a massive [b]thank you[/b] to everyone who joined the battlefield, tested, and shared feedback with us. 🙌
[/p][p]This session was especially important as it gave us a clearer look at the impact of our recent [b]Unreal Engine 5 migration.[/b] While there are still some rough edges to smooth out, the progress is already huge — and your reports helped us spot key issues to improve.[/p][p]But we’re not done yet. 🚀
[/p][p]🔜 [b]Next stop: TPS Fest on Steam![/b]
Mark your calendars:
🗓 [b]August 25th till September 1st (local Steam event time)
[/b]
We’ll be participating in the upcoming [b]Steam Third-Person Shooter Fest[/b], giving even more players the chance to experience [i]Shadows of Soldiers[/i].[/p][p]We can’t wait to show off how far the game has come — and once again, your support is what makes this possible. 💙[/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates as we gear up for TPS Fest — and as always, thank you for being part of this journey.[/p]

notes.title: New Map: HELIX! (TDM)
notes.notes:
[p]Soldiers, it’s time to gear up for a new battlefield. We’ve just added [b]HELIX[/b], a brand-new map built for intense close-quarters combat and tactical flanking.[/p][p]Alongside HELIX, we’re introducing [b]Team Deathmatch[/b] — a pure, action-packed mode where it’s all about racking up eliminations for your squad.[/p][p]⚠ [b]Please note:[/b]
Team Deathmatch is currently [b]available only in player-hosted matches[/b]. In matchmaking, [b]Conquest[/b] remains the sole available mode for now.[/p][p]Jump in, explore HELIX, and see if your team can dominate the kill count![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44517244/94f58173610031ed462cb6715a4f891533a440c3.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44517244/507a119b9199cd6b892353402d72887e7aa61088.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44517244/2ad2ecaff8eaa46053746accdeb457d73699dc2c.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Playtest 5 is coming!
notes.notes: [p]We're sorry about the delay and not being able to consistently keep our promise.[/p][p] We have had some rough few weeks behind us improving hit registration and the migration to UE 5 overall.[/p][p]Incoming Playtest Weekend – August 15th – 17th!  [/p][p]It's time Soldiers, gear up — we're heading back to the battlefield![/p][p]Our next Shadows of Soldiers playtest weekend is officially set for: [/p][list][*][p]August 15th – 20th [/p][/*][*][p]Matchmaking opens Friday at 18:00 CEST and runs until Sunday midnight  [/p][/*][/list][p]This will be a focused test on our latest improvements, including performance updates from our Unreal Engine 5 migration, network tuning, and some early balance changes based on your last feedback.[/p][p]Whether you’re a returning veteran or testing for the first time — we’d love to have you with us.[/p][p]Stay sharp, bring your squad, and be part of building the future of tactical shooters. The next operation is just around the corner.[/p][p]Head over to [url="https://discordapp.com/channels/378098124629082112/1388881980015513731"]https://discordapp.com/channels/378098124629082112/1388881980015513731[/url] For more information and be up to date in what we are  trying to achieve.[/p]

notes.title: The Playtest Has Ended — Thank You, Soldiers! 🔻
notes.notes:
[p]🔻 [b]The Playtest Has Ended — Thank You, Soldiers![/b] 🔻[/p][p]Our fourth playtest is now officially closed.
To every single one of you who joined the fight, tested the new features, and gave feedback — [b]thank you.[/b] 🙏[/p][p]Your support, ideas, and sheer passion are what keep [i]Shadows of Soldiers[/i] moving forward.
We’re a small team, but every weekend like this brings us one step closer to launch.[/p][p]We’re planning the [b]next test weekend for late July[/b], so keep your gear ready. Expect more polish, more improvements… and maybe a few surprises. 👀[/p][p]Until then — stay sharp, stay tactical.
🎖️ [i]See you on the battlefield, soldier[/i][/p]

notes.title: Dedicated server tests and summer announcement!
notes.notes:
Good Morning Shadows,

We have some exciting news!

This weekend we we've been able to test a dedicated server setup.
We are pleased with the results that we have gotten so far.
Now that we know this is working it is time to optimize gameplay for a dedicated server setup.

While we celebrate our summer vacations we will continue the work on the project even though the actual progress might be a bit slower than usual.

When our developers are back from their vacations we do like to invite you all to a new playtest with dedicated servers!
More information will be given in a while so stay tuned.

We hope everybody enjoys a pleasant summer. Do not forget to spend time with friends and family and an occasional party on the side.

Much love!
Team SoS

notes.title: Shadows of Soldiers 3rd playtest is coming!
notes.notes:
[b]Join the Shadows of Soldiers 3rd Playtest![/b]

Attention, shadows! We are thrilled to announce the next playtest for Shadows of Soldiers, our adrenaline-fueled 8v8 third-person cover-based tactical multiplayer shooter.

[b]Date + Time: [/b]
    [b]Start:[/b] Friday 7th of June 10:00 
   [b] End:[/b] Monday 17th of Juni 22:00 
    [b]Timezone:[/b] Times are GMT +2


Get ready to step into the heat of battle and experience firsthand the intense, strategic combat that Shadows of Soldiers has to offer. Here's what you can look forward to:


[b]Choose Your Class:[/b]
- Juggernaut: Lead your team with tactical prowess. Equip powerful abilities like Fury or Punisher to turn the tide of battle.

- Shadow: Operate from the shadows with stealth and precision. Use Cloak to become invisible or Spark to disrupt the battlefield.

- Commander: Support your squad with advanced tech. Deploy Shelter for defense or Bane to close off highly traffic areas.


[b]Customize Your Playstyle:[/b]
Each class offers two unique abilities. Strategically select one to equip and deploy in the heat of battle to tailor your approach and outsmart your enemies.


[b]Engage in Intense 8v8 Combat:[/b]
Team up with friends or join other players in high-stakes battles where teamwork and strategy are key to victory. Utilize cover, coordinate with your squad, and dominate the battlefield.


[b]Provide Crucial Feedback:[/b]
Your feedback is invaluable to us. Participate in this playtest to help us refine and perfect Shadows of Soldiers. Your insights will directly impact the game's development, ensuring a better experience for everyone.

[b]
How to Join:[/b]
- Sign Up: Register for the playtest at https://store.steampowered.com/.../Shadows_of_Soldiers/
- When to download: At the opening date you will recieve a message that the game is added to your library. Then you'd be able to download the game!
- Play and Engage: Jump into the game during the playtest period, have fun, and share your feedback with us.

[b]
Stay Connected:[/b]
Follow us on https://www.facebook.com/shadowsofsoldiers for the latest updates, tips, and community discussions. Join our Discord server at https://discord.gg/rkWhy9TwjX to connect with fellow players and developers.


We can’t wait to see you on the battlefield. Gear up, strategize, and show us what you’ve got!

Sign up now and be part of the action: https://store.steampowered.com/.../Shadows_of_Soldiers/

Greetings,
Team SoS

#ShadowsOfSoldiers #Playtest #GamingCommunity #JoinTheBattle

notes.title: Patch 0.3.0
notes.notes:
**Patch 0.3.0**

This patch is the one that will be live during our second playtest
If you have not read everything since the last playtest then the following is everything added since our latest playtest!

**Latency updates!**
We improved our latency replication on almost everything.
This means the responsiveness of the player will practically always be the same.
However, when you have higher latency in games for example the damage hit on enemies will still have a delay. (as in all games)

- Set the good latency replication for Run Device functions 
- Set the good latency replication for Toll + switch firing mode
- Set the good latency replication for Climb
- Set the good latency replication for Slide
- Set the good latency replication for Take cover
- Set the good latency replication for Mouse Input / ros get off cover when 90+switch shoulder cam 
- Set the good latency replication for Gun down
- Set the good latency replication for Bane
- Set the good latency replication for Shelter
- Set the good latency replication for Spark
- Set the good latency replication for Fury
- Set the good latency replication for Nade throwing
- Set the good latency replication for Firing
- Fixed climb latency issues + hand IK for climb

**Voice chat**
We now have voice chat in the game (not fully tested)
- Add voice chat key binding
- Left alt for talk
- X for showing the players list, joining the team, get the settings

**Map updates!**
We improved our maps quite a bit.
Minimaps are also working better.

- Fixed some lighting on hld_water
- Improved cq_dam fakewater refraction
- Added physmats to hld_water
- Added a bunch of physmats to office 
- Added a bunch of physmats to cq_cliffside

**Device updates!**
A lot of changes have been made to the devices to give them a better balance.
We expect no real unfair behavior during this playtest.

**Weapons and shooting updates!**

notes.title: Come join our second Playtest!
notes.notes:
Dear Shadows,

We are thrilled to invite you to participate in the second playtest of Shadows of Soldiers. 
Your valuable feedback during the initial playtest was instrumental in shaping the game, and we believe your insights will continue to be invaluable as we work towards creating an immersive and captivating gaming experience.

[b]Date and Time:[/b]
Monday 12 February 10:00 GMT+1
Till
Monday 26 February 10:00 GMT+1

[b]How to gain access:[/b]
Click the Request Access button on our steampage to be part of the playtest!
Once the playtest starts you will be able to play.

Those who requested access to our first playtest do no need to request access again.

Your input is crucial in helping us refine Shadows of Soldiers, and we genuinely appreciate your commitment to improving the game.

If you have any [b]questions[/b] or concerns or [b]feedback[/b], feel free to reach out to us at on our Discord.
https://discord.gg/shadowsofsoldiers

We look forward to having you with us for this exciting phase of Shadows of Soldiers!

Best regards,
Levithum (Community manager)
Team SoS

notes.title: Weekend 2 of playtesting
notes.notes:
Hello, Shadows!

Weekend 2 of the playtest is now over!

Next weekend be the third and the last weekend of the playtest before we head into festivities.

We are happy that the matchmaking problems of last week seem to be fixed. While it is not working 100% correctly and we saw some 7v6 this made the game already 10 times more playable.

Once again we have received feedback and have things to work on to make next weekend even better. The most important one will be the experience of being a client. 

For those who have feedback to give. Do so over on our discord or personal messages. Be assured that we do read everything.

We wish you a nice week and hope to see you again next weekend!

Greetings,
Team SoS

notes.title: First weekend of Playtesting
notes.notes:
Hello Shadows,

As per schedule, we have now closed the playtest and the first weekend is over. We look back on a rather successful weekend even though there were some major problems. Still i've had fun and we've seen others have it as well. 

The truth is that we expected some more problems that would break the game and make it not playable. (for example the database not holding up).
Luckily everyone got to experience the gameplay.

As of today, the total signed-up people has reached: 1,315
The number of accounts that have been created where: 828

We cannot express our gratitude for your helping us out with feedback and bug reports and would love to keep receiving those.

While we cannot prevent games from being unbalanced because people left the lobby, We will take our time to try and solve some bigger problems like the balancing when joining an ongoing lobby. 

We have seen that there are a lot of you who do not use the Playtest channels. Make sure to read the Playtest Welcome channel and select "Have read" at the bottom. This will open up a lot more channels where you can contribute to the project.

For those willing to support the project. Likes, shares, and comments will gain more attention, and supporting us through Patreon will make us progress faster.

We'd love to see you again this coming Friday at 12:00 GMT +1 for our second week of the playtest!

Discord: https://discord.gg/shadowsofsoldiers
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/shadowsofsoldiers
Website: https://www.shadowsofsoldiers.com/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/shadowsofsoldiers

Greetings, 

Levithum
(Community Manager)

notes.title: Major update 0.2.0 is here!
notes.notes:
Welcome to the 0.2.0 patch notes!
This is the patch that will be run on the playtest and since last patch notes there is a lot to cover.
We will split the things in different sections. Fixed bugs, Adjusted and New things.


Things that have been fixed:
- Many small fixes which will make the list to long to make. These where around 120..
- Weapon issues in the main menu/ingame as characters where holding wrong weapons/weapon sizes
- Loading weapons attachments ingame as client, V1 to V4 were not a solution so V5 is. Attachments now work on the client side.
- Possible fix for 1 of our main crash (working so far)
- Forbid climbing on objects where we should not.
- Fix where slide speed was not as intended
- Movement speed issues where players did not get the correct speed at certain times.
- Handguns issues where gun was not functioning properly
- Emp nade issues where the nade was not doing anything.
- Can't join the server or host match after the previous one got disbanded or destroyed (even if the host force closed match/game)
- Stuck at loading screen as client
- Disabled Fsr2 due to it giving a lot of problems.
- Lobby team issues (these where many)
- Spawning in the correct team
- Some code optimization
- Sighting rebuild
- Sobby name issues
- Scoreboard update
- Playing duplicated sounds for clients
- Minimap points colors
- Tdm scores+ui colors
- Fixed fury hit montages + camera
- Changed Acog scope mesh/materials
- Ready time resetting while firing after you stop running.
- Player camera not going properly aiming down to the character when hit by fury
- Capture sounds started playing when 1v1 and didn’t stop when capturing or dying on capture zone
- Capture points not resetting correctly 
- Ammo pickup sound being duplicated
- Fixed issue where reloading UI stayed on screen when hit by Fury
- Fixed by where an empty kill log was seen as white boxes.
- Point resetting
- End round/match point flags
- Get selected teams in the game from the lobby
- Capture progress bar + sound fix 
- Remained default kill log
- Materials for some weapons
- Client sniper scopes
- Capture bar+sound disappearing
- New player registering 
- Teleport at a slim object and A/D pressing while the cam is in character
- Overtime and captured point time together goes to minus
- floating name fix v1 (enemy can see player name+bar)
- Set restrict when buying stuff grant for owner class only
- Fixed server browser match finding issue
- Fix for problem where host couldn’t host another match after previously disbanding one.
- Fixed juggernaut effect to be less in your face
- Fixed lobby issues
-Fixed some drone issues
-fixed Nade throwing issues 
- match result fix
- spawn camera on some maps
- reduce mine ambiance to 75% volume
- sound issues + set sounds as attached when needed
- save selected class when someone leaves the lobby

Map fixing:
- Cq_cliffside optimization/minimap optimization
- A bunch of cq_excavation collision bugs
- Cq_abbey capture points
- Some cq_abbey optimization and bug fixes
- minimap fixes for m.s. echo


Things that have been adjusted
Adjusted:
- 30% more bullet spread when non ADS
- Cover adjustments
- Tutorial map update
- Getting hit responding
- Updated kill log
- Some UI (color + positions)
- Spectator free cam for everyone , num5 to activate, num4 previous,num6 next player view
-**Color response** >> Red color is always about the enemy's team, our green is our team:
- Killer/victim in kill log
- Capturing progress bar + progress %
- Capture floating-point letters
- Amount players on actual capture points (yours vs the enemy team)
- Capture point floor color (even when ongoing capture)
- Scoreboard (seems like we are always in the green team)
- Main top capture point letters
- Lobby panels
- Winning team X1.2 score at the end of the match
- Increased the respawn timer from 3 to 6 seconds
- Clients now can better feel the recoil.
- Made top right UI smaller.
- Disable shoulder switch while bolt pull to prevent bolt pull from getting stuck and the player unable to shoot
- Visibility when the player used Fury.
- Run speed 600 >> 520 
- Delay for ready to spawn 3 >> 6 secs 
- Cancel reload by R disabled
- Optimize cq_abbey minimap
-ui words scale
-chat new line for long message + scrolling possibility + last line seeing
-some minimap update
-server browser menu
-team change always on in lobby
-6v6 max players
- We built the shipment version of the game what means: 
This is the configuration for optimal performance and shipping your game.
This configuration strips out console commands, stats, and profiling tools.
- Normal firing can be heard more further
- Cover title

Devices:

- Drone
	Longer shoot distance was 1700(18m) now 2400(24m)
	Increased fire rate. 170 -> 300
	Duration increased 15 -> 20 seconds
	Set damage calculations the same as weapons -15
	Show floating damage numbers
	Increased hp. 250 –> 400
	

- Shelter
	Increase width and height.
	Reduced spawn time to 0 (instant)
	Increased duration from 10 –> 15 seconds
	Doubled health regeneration
	Disabled the shelter wall disable function when pressing F again.

- Spark
	No time slow for teammates anymore

Decreased spawning time by 25%

Reduce duration from 10 -> 8 seconds
	Reduce knockdown time to 2.5 seconds instead of 5 seconds
Reduce damage from 75 -> 30

will not reset upon respawn, except round/warmup start (similar remaining like device power)


New things:

for example:
own total score:10.000
lvl:20
